_comment: Corrections applied on top of africa-g2p. `universal` fills in letters that individual rule sets omit even though the orthography uses them - the values are the conventional readings of these letters across Ghanaian Latin orthographies. `per_rules` fixes mappings that are wrong rather than missing, keyed by africa-g2p rule code. Every entry is applied only when the rule set does not already handle the character, so a language's own rules always win.

c.note: c is /t͡ʃ/ in most Ghanaian orthographies

y.note: africa-g2p maps Ewe orthographic <y> to IPA y (a front rounded vowel). In Ewe <y> is the palatal glide /j/, as it is in every other language in this set.
